$comment: Targeted input for SoundSweepTest(s) where a program's sound needs a particular action (steps use the scenario format plus hold/move). expect_silent: the exercised path is silent by design. generic_s: seconds of the generic play script.

game.treecheckers.note: Sounds only when a move captures (KillsChk: Snd(62);Sleep(100);Snd). The drags are a capture on the layout entropy 12345 gives (found by a greedy two-player driver reading u[] from the VM).

game.maze.note: Beep;Beep when SolveMaze, started by a right-click, leaves the window; any key aborts the solve (ScanChar -> throw), so no keys.

demo.hanoi.note: Beep;Beep once all 63 moves of the 6 disks are done, then PressAKey.

game.battlelines.note: Snd(86) while troopers of both sides are within range and fire; holding the left button pulls the human troopers toward the pointer, into the enemy.
